stop_rules.merge_floor_source: collapse guard relative to this round's initial validation (the LA rows have no earlier score); the static 0.3 floor is recorded only
stop_rules.checked_at: every periodic validation (interventions, relative merge floor, collision regression, free-road stops)

collision_regression.stops_when: a validation case collides that did not collide in this round's initial validation, or the validation has more collisions in total than the initial validation
collision_regression.training_rollouts: collisions keep their -20 reward and are recorded in updates/*.json; they do not stop the run by themselves

stop_rules.collision_source: the v14 starting policy already collides in the focused northbound LA merge (validation case 10), so "any collision" would stop the round before it trains

free_road_stop_regression.stops_when: free-road stopped decisions exceed both the minimum and factor x this round's initial validation
free_road_stop_regression.definition: speed before the decision below 0.1 m/s, no own-lane leader within 20 m and an eligible target of at least 5 m/s (traffic.highway_flow_rl_v14_stop_fix.STOP_SETTINGS)
free_road_stop_regression.source: round 20 validations: 0, 0, 25, 64 and 180 free-road stopped decisions (initial, updates 31, 56 and 91, final)
